After five years of a serious norco addiction, I have made it to day five. I was taking 10, 10/325 mg Norcos a day and whatever else I could get my hands on. I've wanted to stop before, but was always afraid of the nasty withdrawal symptoms. Five days ago I thought it was impossible. I nearly clawed the paint off the walls, I had the runs like Niagara Falls and I couldn't sleep for shit. But day after day, I told myself it would get better. Even if it was just one less trip to the shitter. Day two was worse and day three I nearly gave up and bought my fix. But instead I gave my keys,atm card and cell phone to my brother. The agony was unbearable. Slept like hell night three as well. But I made it to day four and grinding through I noticed things WERE getting easier. I was able to keep food down and actually caught a few naps. And here we are now on nearly the end of day five and everything has become much easier. I am actually able to function, to an extent. All the pain is gone, the anxiety is gone and what once seemed impossible has become a reality. I am still fatigued and don't have the energy that I used to have, but I have overcome the initial 96 hours of hell. Being at day five now, I wish I could have told myself on day one, it will get better long ago instead of pissing thousands of dollars away. Everyone always says it does get easier, but once you experience it and endure the pain and suffering, the grass really is greener on the other side. I know I am far from out of the woods, but this is the farthest I've cone from getting off those nasty little pills.
